Indexes gate-freeze.md as the harness contract landing point without claiming an implemented CLI.
Records gate freeze as a planned command surface and requires unsupported_command_surface until #1508 adds commands to the mechanical matrix.
Evidence map binds behavior evidence, command matrix boundary proof, focused validation, and fresh verification input for WI-1507.
Task carrier links WI-1507 to GitHub issue #1507 as tracking-only primary carrier.
